properties.site-address: Bartram Farm, Old Otford Road, Sevenoaks
properties.notes: The site is located adjacent to Sevenoaks urban confines. There is existing access onto Old Otford Road which could be utilised if improved. Overall the site is considered able to accommodate development, and is most suited to employment development given the adjacent uses, however it is located within the Green Belt so this designation would need to change in order for it to be developed.
properties.ownership-status: not owned by a public authority
